title: Pan-Seared Norwegian Skewers with Crispy Croutons
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring Norwegian skewers, crispy croutons, and a hint of smoky guanciale.
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Toss the yellowed onion croutons in the bowl to coat.
Spread the croutons on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the guanciale in a pan over medium heat until crispy.
Remove the guanciale from the pan and set aside.
Add the Norwegian skewers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve the skewers with crispy croutons and guanciale on top.
Optional: Serve with a side of your choice.
